item.title: Episode 04: Context Window Dynamics and Attention Degradation
item.description: The mechanics of transformer attention: the 'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon, needle-in-a-haystack limits, token budgets, and why bigger context windows are not an excuse for bad memory hygiene. Homework: Calculate your agent's maximum prompt overhead (system prompt + tool schemas) and define a strict working budget.

item.title: Episode 03: The System Prompt as an Operating System Kernel
item.description: Metaprompting, behavioral contracts, state machines defined in system prompts, and setting defensive boundaries against prompt injection. Homework: Write your assistant's core 'Kernel Prompt' defining strict behavioral boundaries and input-output contracts.

item.title: Episode 02: Choosing the Brain - Local Engines vs Cloud APIs
item.description: Local inference (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, quantized GGUF models) vs Frontier Cloud APIs (Gemini 2.5/3.8, Claude 3.5, GPT-4o). Latency, privacy guarantees, inference cost at scale, and hybrid routing architectures. Homework: Set up a local LLM runner (like Ollama or vLLM) alongside a cloud API key, and benchmark inference time per token.

channel.title: Building Your Sovereign AI Assistant
channel.itunes:author: Sophie & Mark
channel.description: A 35-part serialized engineering masterclass on designing, coding, and deploying an autonomous personal AI agent from scratch.

item.title: Episode 01: Beyond Chatbots - The Anatomy of an Autonomous Agent
item.description: The difference between passive LLM query-response and autonomous agents. The ReAct loop (Perception, Working Memory, Planning, Action, Reflection). Designing for deterministic execution. Homework: Draft the architectural block diagram of your dream assistant: separate brain, memory, tools, and sensors.
